counterSemantics.exclusions: Live current-backend context tree only; no glibc arena/RSS accounting, inactive context caches, other backend/process or shared-memory totals.
counterSemantics.residentMemoryMeaning: total/free/used are context capacity/accounting, not resident pages. Never subtract/add them to RSS/PSS/native cgroup sums to claim exact native ownership.

sourceReferences.fact: Fresh zeroed counters per context; context->methods->stats called on that context, then children recursively enumerated once; materialized SRF begins at TopMemoryContext.
totalspace is bytes requested from malloc, freespace unused portion; counters are AllocSet-oriented.
Context initially owns its own malloc block including header; stats sums own context header/blocks/free chunks, not children.

counterSemantics.usedMeaning: Allocator/context occupied bytes, including headers/overhead; not just live SQL values or logical JSONB bytes.

fixedRecordContract.binder: Actual same CAS PID/non-forced pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned() text/expected+new revision tuples; new revision/request hash/nonce cross-bind to unchanged driver request/ACK evidence. Preserve XID as exact string, not float.
fixedRecordContract.correlation: Exactly one session binder followed by two ordered points per successful CAS with the same PID/XID/revisions/raw GUC/roles/logging GUC values. Backend PID may differ across requests; do not pretend one backend for the full case.
fixedRecordContract.counterGuards: contextCount integer1..4096; memory counters integer0..INT64_MAX; no NaN/float/bool aliases/missing/coalesce0; total=used+free.
fixedRecordContract.existingCounts: 27 genuineRPC,3round,5read/4CAS/18control,6 boundary triplets;4successfulCAS includes restore. No added reads/controls/forced-GC/cache eviction/role/session tricks.
fixedRecordContract.lengths: Both null before materialization; nonnegative bounded O(1) scalars after cast. No traversal/hash/copy of large outputs for instrumentation.
fixedRecordContract.rawGuards: current/session role identifiers<=63UTF8B; raw projection/scope null or text<=128UTF8B; raw projection exactly on rejects before branch, all actual values otherwise preserved rather than manufactured OFF/NULL.

loggingRequiredGuards.policy: Only these two logging GUCs are diagnostic startup changes. Preserve all original memory/CPU/deadline/auth/return/ACK settings. Raw capture must remain bounded and must not leak statements/stacks/context names/payloads.

sourceReferences.fact: STATEMENT is separately appended. LOG qualifies under defaultERROR policy, so terse alone does not suppress top SQL.
RAISE emits with no hide_stmt/hide_ctx flags.

observerLimitations: InitMaterializedSRF creates a tuplestore and internally materializes all9 view columns, including context name/ident/parent text, even when the caller exports only four aggregate scalars. No names/identifiers/query payloads may appear in emitted records.
Traversal and tuple construction allocate between context-row samples; totals are not an atomic backend snapshot and include observer query/SRF/aggregate/record/LOG allocation and cache effects.
Context-count1..4096 is a result guard, not a hard limit on SRF internal enumeration/materialization. Existing statement/native/time/evidence limits remain actual work bounds.

Before point is before array_to_string while renderer_chunks are live. After point follows text construction, renderer_chunks:=NULL, UNIQUE JSON/text-size checks and output_value::jsonb. Delta includes all of those plus observer work, not just cast or representation size.

After-only O(1) octet_length(output_text)/pg_column_size(output_value) are supplementary scalar lengths, not allocation-size decomposition. Original checks and their order must remain; added function/cache overhead is observer work.
